body.plain_text: Run the Euclidean algorithm 84 = 2*30 + 24, 30 = 1*24 + 6, 24 = 4*6. Then reverse the steps to obtain 6 = 30 - 24 = 30 - (84 - 2*30) = 3*30 - 84.
body.markdown: Run the Euclidean algorithm $84 = 2\cdot 30 + 24$, $30 = 24 + 6$, and $24 = 4\cdot 6$. Then reverse the steps to obtain $6 = 30 - 24 = 30 - (84 - 2\cdot30) = 3\cdot30 - 84$.

content.plain_text: Compute remainders until the gcd appears as the last nonzero remainder.
content.markdown: Compute remainders until the gcd appears as the last nonzero remainder.

content.plain_text: Rewrite 6 using the previous equations until only 84 and 30 remain.
content.markdown: Rewrite $6$ using the previous equations until only $84$ and $30$ remain.
